Validate a compositional dataset

Source: R/utils_composition.R
check_composition.Rd

Checks that the composition parts are present in the data, numeric, strictly positive, free of missing values, and (optionally) that every row sums to the expected total.

Usage

check_composition(data, parts, total = NULL, tol = 0.01, allow_zero = FALSE)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the composition.

parts

Character vector of column names making up the composition (at least two parts).

total

Expected row total for the parts (e.g., 1440 for minutes in a 24-hour day). If NULL (default), row totals are not checked.

tol

Numeric tolerance for the row-total check, as a proportion of total (default 0.01, i.e., 1%). The margin allows for the imprecision of accelerometer- or diary-derived time-use minutes, which rarely sum to exactly 1440.

allow_zero

Logical. If FALSE (default), parts must be strictly positive. If TRUE, zeroes are permitted and only negative values are rejected, for data whose zeroes are imputed before any log-ratio transformation, as in declare_composition().

Value

data, invisibly, if all checks pass; otherwise an informative error.

See also

Other composition helpers: geom_mean_comp(), ilr_backtransform(), ilr_transform(), variation_matrix()

Examples

check_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"), total = 1440)
